title: Decision: refused Message/set creates fail the whole call with invalidArguments
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (cefc217) L424/L430: the server MUST reject a Message/set create (roomed Chat / mimi-fanout body type) 'with invalidArguments'. RFC 8620 L1189 defines invalidArguments as a method-level error; its SetError list has no invalidArguments. Readings: per-object SetError vs method-level error. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-19): method-level; the whole Message/set call is answered with error invalidArguments. Also applies to the L426 body/bodyType/reactions update rule.
